tasks.title: Strict-overlap interval union
tasks.instruction: Return {"intervals":[[start,end],...]}. Discard empty intervals. Merge intervals only if their intersection has positive length, including transitive overlap. Touching intervals remain separate. Sort by start then end.
tasks.visible_rule: Exact JSON shape; sorted positive-length disjoint intervals; touching allowed. Original coverage and exact endpoints are checked only by final acceptance.

tasks.title: Idempotent transfer ledger
tasks.instruction: Return {"balances":{"A":integer,"B":integer,"C":integer}}. Process events in order; event ID first occurrence wins. Transfers debit source and credit destination; no overdraft restriction. A reverse undoes a known, not-yet-reversed transfer once; unknown or already reversed transfer is a no-op. Transfer IDs in first-occurrence transfers are unique.
tasks.visible_rule: Exact JSON shape; integer balances for A/B/C; conserve initial total. Exact balances are checked only by final acceptance.

tasks.title: Shortest path with lexical tie-break
tasks.instruction: Return {"path":[node,...],"cost":integer}. Find a minimum-cost simple directed path from S to T. For equal cost choose lexicographically smallest full node sequence under ordinary string order.
tasks.visible_rule: Exact JSON shape; path starts/ends correctly, uses existing directed edges, has no repeated nodes, and reported cost equals sum. Optimality and lexical tie-break checked only by final acceptance.

tasks.title: Small 0/1 packing
tasks.instruction: Return {"ids":[item,...],"weight":integer,"value":integer}. Choose each item at most once with weight <= capacity. Maximize value, then minimize weight, then choose lexicographically smallest sorted ID list (shorter equal-prefix list first).
tasks.visible_rule: Exact JSON shape; sorted unique existing IDs; reported weight/value equal sums; within capacity. Optimality and tie-break checked only by final acceptance.
